newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint steady vs basket, weaker vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint steady vs basket, weaker vs dlr.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed steady against the central bank's currency basket, finishing trade at the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level, dealers said.
The Hungarian currency fell, however, against the soaring dollar, ending trade at 196.10/15 to the U.S. currency, more than a forint below its opening level of 195.05/10, they said.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
